description:
250W EU EPAC-Compliant Hub Motor

Integrated 250W motor (EU-certified) delivers efficient torque for 15-25% inclines, ideal for loaded commutes or mountain ascents. Balances power output with range while meeting EU e-bike safety standards.

700C All-Terrain Tires

700C All-Terrain Tires offer superior traction on wet urban roads, gravel, and dirt. Reinforced tread grips all weather; 30-60 PSI adaptability for versatile terrain handling.
Lightweight Aluminum Alloy Frame

Lightweight Aluminum Alloy Frame

Aluminum frame with hydroformed tubing for rigidity and corrosion resistance. Matte finish withstands Mediterranean heat and Baltic humidity; low-maintenance, durable design.

Single-Speed Belt Drive System

Silent, maintenance-free carbon-reinforced belt replaces chains—no oil, rust, or drops. Simple single-speed design ensures reliability on steep climbs/descents, perfect for urban commuting and eco-friendly rides.

Long-Range Battery (100-130km)

15Ah lithium battery provides 100-130km range (mixed terrain tested). Smart BMS ensures consistent power; 4-6hr fast charge for multi-day tours or long-distance adventures across Europe.
